reuse.why: There was no existing duplicate-link check to reuse; the change uses the tree's db.first query helper and adds one guard rather than five inline queries.

duplication.why: The check is defined once and each of the five link functions only calls it; the provider string literal is repeated at each call alongside the identical literal the function already writes to account_sync_source.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers that use it, consistent with the tree, though accounts/link.ts (which holds findOrCreateBank) would also have been a natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and a release note.

maintainability.why: Definition of 'linked' is one SQL query in one function; the five copied link functions remain but that was pre-existing.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction for this rule; all five link paths go through the new guard.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the rule is not reshaped per provider.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called first in linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
